summary.text: Michael Eckels Jr. is the Democratic candidate for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 35A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary.
A consultant and minister, he described himself in a Ballotpedia survey as a lifelong member of the Harford and Cecil County communities.

paragraphs.text: Eckels said in a Ballotpedia survey that he attended Southampton Middle School, C. Milton Wright High School, Harford Community College and Towson University.
Ballotpedia lists a bachelor's degree from Towson University in 2014.
Eckels named lowering the cost of living, supporting first responders, teachers, nurses and farmers, and using renewable energy to create jobs and lower energy costs as his key messages.
